messages:
erin: Heads-up: small hotfix ready for serializer crash on ~250+ token requests in prod. Image `redwood/serving:2.4.1-hotfix`. No schema/client changes. Requesting expedited 00:45-01:15 UTC window. Plan: smoke -> 4% canary -> ramp 100% in 10m if green. Auto-rollback if 5xx > 0.4% over 1m OR p95 latency > 600ms for 2m.

deploy-bot: Deploy request submitted by @erin
- image: `redwood/serving:2.4.1-hotfix`
- targets: eu-west1,canary-pool
- strategy: canary 4% -> 100%
- smoke job: `smoke/serializer-regression`

josh: quick Q: does this touch KV cache behavior?

erin: no, only tokenizer bounds + null-checks. cache unchanged.

anya: I can +1 expedited if ops oncall watches and rollback gate is automatic.

ops-bot: Paging oncall: @mike please ack within 5m to avoid auto-escalation.

mike: ack. I'll monitor traces and trigger rollback if probe trips.

josh: :+1: Also add short release-note blurb and link to runbook.

erin: release note: "2.4.1-hotfix: fix serializer crash on long inputs causing 5xx errors. No client changes." runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/serializer-2-4-1

deploy-bot: Scheduled: start 1865432160 -> starting smoke. CLI preview:
```
/deploy --image redwood/serving:2.4.1-hotfix \
  --targets eu-west1,canary-pool --strategy canary --canary-percent 4 \
  --smoke smoke/serializer-regression --rollback-probe "5xx>0.4||p95>600"
```
erin: smoke passed, no errors. kicking canary now.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 4% at 1865432170. Observability hooks active.

mike: watching metrics, nothing suspicious.

(8m later)
erin: ramping to 100% per fast-approve. closing window in 20m with post-deploy note. thanks all for quick responses :rocket:

josh: thanks. ping support if any tickets surface.
